releaseNotes:
﻿## Guest Inbox
- Fix “already linked” when saving a booking from a multi-person thread (Cc recommenders no longer block the recommended guest)
- Mark conversations unread from the inbox list (blue unread indicator)
- New roomless inquiries no longer default “Waiting for availability” on

## Bookings / Rooms
- Room selection re-checks occupancy after you change arrival or departure dates (stale “occupied” warnings cleared when the room is free)
- Room availability and conflict checks include conference guest stays that run longer (or start earlier) than the conference dates
